description: "Poems by Speranza" by Lady Wilde is a collection of poetry likely written in the late 19th century. The poems reflect deep nationalistic sentiments and observations regarding social injustice, particularly focusing on themes of Irish struggle, identity, and the emotional toll of suffering under oppression."  The opening of the collection introduces the reader to a dedication to Ireland, immediately establishing the patriotic tone of the work.
